name: Is it better to brush, roll, or spray interior trim?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to brush, roll, or spray interior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brushing, rolling, and spraying each offer distinct practical advantages depending on the job environment. Spraying delivers an ultra-smooth, brushmark-free finish, making it ideal for vacant remodels, newly installed trim, or whole-house projects where complete masking is practical. Brushing and rolling using mini-microfiber rollers is preferred in furnished, occupied homes because it eliminates overspray risk and requires less aggressive masking. Skilful brushwork with self-leveling trim enamels produces a durable, professional finish without turning an occupied residence into a plastic-sealed spray booth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spraying gives the smoothest finish for vacant homes or new installs. Hand-brushing and rolling are best for occupied homes to avoid overspray while delivering clean lines.
